whoWeServe.intro: Four groups rely on us for the requirements that standard distribution does not cover — each with its own intake route, documentation set, and point of contact.

items.title: Hospitals & Procurement Teams
items.desc: We quote against your tender line list with the certification reference attached to every item, so wards and theatres are never held up waiting on a missing line.
items.serves: Supplied to hospitals, multi-specialty clinics, diagnostic and pathology laboratories, ambulatory surgical centers, and government procurement programs.

items.title: Clinicians & Oncology Teams
items.desc: Named-patient and cross-border access to therapies not yet registered in your market, supported by the manufacturer documentation your pharmacy committee and regulator will ask to see.

items.title: Distributors & Manufacturer Partners
items.desc: Cross-border reach into markets that are difficult to serve directly, through a two-hub network built for sourcing, consolidation, and onward distribution.

items.title: Patients & Families
items.desc: Guidance through the named-patient process, coordinated with your treating doctor and handled with urgency and confidentiality.

howItWorks.intro: Here's exactly what happens after you send a requirement or clinical request — step by step, for either track.

tracks.name: Hospital Procurement
tracks.summary: For facilities, procurement officers, and tender teams sourcing medical-surgical consumables at volume.

steps.title: Requirement
steps.desc: You send a requirement or tender line list — product, specification, volume, destination. No login or account required.

steps.title: Quotation & Specification
steps.desc: We return a quote line by line, with the product specifications and certification references attached to each item.

steps.title: Order & Documentation
steps.desc: On approval we confirm the order and compile the documentation pack your procurement, pharmacy, and regulatory reviewers need.

steps.title: Consolidated Fulfilment
steps.desc: Dispatch from our India sourcing hub or Philippines logistics hub, consolidated where possible and cold-chain controlled where the product requires it.

tracks.name: Specialty & Named-Patient Access
tracks.summary: For treating physicians and hospital pharmacies sourcing a medicine that is not registered or not available locally.

steps.title: Clinical Request
steps.desc: The treating physician submits the product, strength, quantity, and patient context for a named-patient requisition.

steps.title: Sourcing & Verification
steps.desc: We source from verified manufacturers and assemble the Certificates of Analysis and manufacturing credentials for clinical and regulatory review.

steps.title: Regulatory Pathway
steps.desc: We support the import permit and named-patient documentation required by the destination market, working to the prescriber's timeline.

steps.title: Cold-Chain Delivery
steps.desc: Temperature-monitored shipment direct to the treating facility, with the chain of custody documented from dispatch to handover.

globalNetwork.narrative: Bishnoi Omniverse LLP in New Delhi is our sourcing hub, working directly with certified manufacturers across India's pharmaceutical and medical-device base. Bishnoi Omniverse Corp in Metro Manila is our Asia-Pacific logistics and operations hub, tied to Getmeds Philippines Inc. / 2MG Inc. Between them we serve hospitals, clinics, and trade partners across more than 50 countries.

governance.title: Held to a Global Standard
governance.body: Bishnoi Omniverse's parent, the Bishnoi Group, has been an active participant in the United Nations Global Compact since November 2024, with Communications on Progress filed for 2025 and 2026. Group leadership represented these commitments at the UN Global Compact Forward Faster Now | APAC Conference 2026 in Colombo, Sri Lanka.

productStandard.title: Certification, product by product
productStandard.lead: Certification and regulatory documentation vary by product category and destination market, so we document quality where it can be checked — on the product, with the paperwork that supports it.

points.title: Medical Devices
points.desc: CE marking and CMDR approvals, with specification sheets and registration references available on request — for example CMDR-2023-01556 on the Bishnoi Omniverse™ blood transfusion set.

points.title: Pharmaceuticals
points.desc: WHO-GMP certified manufacturing and Certificates of Analysis, including for the Carboget™ / Bishnoi Omniverse™ carboplatin injection supplied under named-patient access.

points.title: Medical Gas Cylinders
points.desc: ISO 9809-1 manufacture with DOT/TPED certification on high-pressure seamless steel cylinders, documented per batch.
